notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.14
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41619654/f8bad3995143e93b63eb9ac4102c1c5dbac1f95d.png[/img]

Hello Lucky fans,

Thanks to everyone who suggested adding achievements! We've done just that with this update, with achievements for collecting hidden presents, completing Red Coin and Timed Trial modes, and more! 

We've also included a few bug fixes.

Patch details:
[list]
[*]Achievements added. [list][*][i]Note: to unlock the wrapped present trophies, open them via the trophy shelf. If you've already opened them, select them and press A to trigger the unlock.[/i][/list][*]Fixed some enemies that weren't correctly approaching to attack you.
[*]Fix for intro cinematic not being shown when selecting non-English at start.
[*]Additional visual fixes.
[/list]

<3 The Playful Team
